author: The Infographics Show
description:
World War III has begun and you’re trapped at 35,000 feet when the first nuclear weapons hit America. 
United Flight 1202 is cruising toward Los Angeles when a blinding flash erupts outside the cabin. Moments later, Chicago disappears beneath a rising mushroom cloud. Then everything starts shutting down.
Air traffic control goes silent, navigation systems fail, communications disappear, electromagnetic pulses knock out critical electronics, leaving the pilots with little more than mechanical backup instruments, limited fuel, and no certainty that the airports ahead even exist anymore.

This hour-by-hour survival simulation follows the passengers and crew as they attempt the impossible: land a crippled commercial aircraft while nuclear war unfolds below them. But surviving the landing is only the beginning. title: World War 3 - Hour by Hour at 35,000 Feet
